response.rationale: R5 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the vignette, including fever, conjunctivitis, and elevated inflammatory markers, which are all consistent with Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in Children (MIS-C). R1 is the runner-up because it has some support from the imaging studies, but it lacks the breadth of support seen in R5.
